violated_contract: Every durable pending queue entry must retain a discoverable dispatch owner, including across duplicate admission, active completion and expiry retirement. A lost immediate kick must not remove its recovery path.
canonical_prevention: Use one transactional owner-creation primitive for admission and repair; retain idle owners and fencing epochs when releasing active work instead of deleting them. Reconcile missing owners from a bounded rotating pending scan, rechecking pending presence and existing ownership transactionally. Cover admission, completion, both retirement paths, real transaction contention, idempotent repair, and flag-off idle-owner behavior.
